---
title: Title and subtitle
---

`lt_header()` puts a title, and optionally a subtitle, above the table. Wrap text in `I()` for raw HTML.

```{r}
library(lt)
d = head(iris[, 4:5], 3)
lt(d) |> lt_header("Iris Measurements")
lt(d) |> lt_header("Iris Measurements", "First three observations")
lt(d) |> lt_header(I("<em>Iris</em> Measurements"), I("<b>Petal width</b> only"))
```
